spec_case: issue #442's first item (#537): a tree dynamic's combined failure text names each branch's own exception class
description: `tree-failure-class-names`'s second companion case (one document would otherwise get unwieldy): a `flow: tree` dynamic (`max_concurrency: 1`, `on_error: continue`) with three branches that each fail a broken condition, not a tool: a named `if` with a `mode: cel` expression that divides by zero (CelEvaluationError), a named `loop` with the same expression as its `while` condition (CelEvaluationError), and a named `if` in `mode: model` whose scripted reply ("maybe") doesn't parse as yes/no (AnswerParseError). `fan.meta.error` names every branch's own displayed class the same way `tree-failure-class-names` does; each CEL branch's own evaluator text (`division by zero`) is masked by the conformance harness's own message-shape catalogue (tests/conformance/README.md), not pinned by this case.
